note: SESNSP open-data page: scraped at each download for the current 'Municipal-Delitos' link (the file URL changes every month). Not verified from the sandbox where this module was written.

Direct URL of the current municipal file 'Municipal-Delitos-2015-<year>_<mon><year>.zip' (or .csv). Fill it in when the scrape of the page finds nothing; a Google Drive share link is accepted and converted.
Optional: URL of the state file 'Estatal-Delitos-2015-<year>_<mon><year>.csv'. When a copy exists, the state rows come from it instead of the sum of the municipios.

CONAPO municipal projections 2015-2030 (columns RENGLON, CLAVE, CLAVE_ENT, NOM_ENT, MUN, SEXO, AÑO, POB). The CONAPO/datos.gob.mx originals returned 404 (2026-11-03); this is the copy kept by datamx.io (Codeando México) of the withdrawn official file, no licence stated: personal use only. Replace by the official 2020-2040 municipal projections (CONAPO 'pry23') once a direct file link is found; any CSV/XLSX with a 5-digit municipal key, a year and a population column works.
Optional second population file (the 2015-2030 base used to come in two parts). Empty = not downloaded.
Optional: direct URL of an INEGI Marco Geoestadístico zip that contains 00ent.shp and 00mun.shp (CVEGEO, NOMGEO). Empty = geoBoundaries ADM1/ADM2 (CC BY 4.0).
